summary: Horace Mann Educators Corp (HMN) filed an 8-K to report entry into a Master Transaction Agreement to acquire Reserve National Insurance Company (RNIC) from Medical Mutual of Ohio and Medical Mutual Life Insurance Company. The stock purchase price is approximately $125 million, plus a ~$7.4 million ceding commission for a related reinsurance transaction. The net purchase price includes ~$10 million of excess statutory capital expected to remain in RNIC. The board approved the deal. Funding will come from cash on hand and borrowings under HMN's existing credit facility. Certain RNIC Medicare supplement policies are excluded and will be reinsured prior to closing. Watch for regulatory approvals and financing execution.
